EXE="$APP/Contents/MacOS/Mycelium A13 Demo"

refuse() {

}

[ -f SHA256SUMS ] || refuse "SHA256SUMS is missing"
for doc in installation-package-manifest.json install-source.json "Install Mycelium.command" APP-FILES.sha256; do

fi
